question: Who among the following Indian artists won the ‘Joan Miro Prize’ for the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nalini Malani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian contemporary artist Nalini Malani has won the Joan Miro Prize for 2019.**
 
• The** award is named after Spanish painter and sculptor Joan Miro, **one of the most influential artists of the 20th century.
 
• The **award is given by Fundacio Joan Miro, the Spanish art museum along with the bank La Caixa.**
 
• La Caixa will provide** Malani with** **a €70,000 (Rs. 54.5 lakh) award.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Joan Miro Prize**

 
 
• ​The Joan Miro Prize is** awarded every two years by the Fundacio Joan Miro and Obra Social "la Caixa".**
 
• Recognizes present-day work by** artists who show the same spirit of exploration, innovation, commitment, and freedom that characterized Joan Miro's life and work.**
 
• **First awarded in 2007,** the prize is conferred by an international panel of judges made up of acclaimed professionals in the field of contemporary creation.
 
• **"la Caixa" Foundation provides a cash prize of €70,000.**
 
• Foundation also covers the cost of producing a monographic exhibition of the work by the winning artist, to be held at Fundació Joan Miro.
 
• **Winners of the Awards so far**:
 
 
• **2019: Nalini Malani**
 
• **2017: Kader Attia**
 
• **2015: Ignasi Aballí**
 
• **2013: Roni Horn**
 
• **2011: Mona Hatoum**
 
• **2009: Pipilotti Rist**
 
• **2007: Olafur Eliasson**
